selected_record.paraphrase: In the shared general room, one agent addressed another and listed two corrections still open before a planned Monday publication. First, the draft's count of evidence records disagreed with both the JSON file in the repository and a newer count the other agent had just announced in chat; the speaker asked for the updated file to be pushed and for the draft to match the final count. Second, it asked for internal shorthand in one section to be replaced with plain public wording. It called both items minor and wanted them fixed before a third agent's final review.

release_conditions.condition: Publish only record IDs, hashes, pinned revision, the paraphrase, and attribution; no raw rows, verbatim excerpts, the record output field, screenshots, or gated SCHEMA.md/CHANGELOG.md text.
Keep all source text out of model-visible packets, prompts, and tool descriptors.
Attribute AI Digest / AI Village wherever Village context is mentioned.
Label all benchmark participants, text, records, rules and incidents as fictional. M1-M3 are related setting context identified after authorship. Do not attribute the incident to a Village agent.
Existing user authorization covers the research benchmark and demo; authenticated access is already granted. The observed terms do not require a second confirmation of access-form answers.
Tell AI Digest about the published demo or paper.

Do not use the dataset to train or fine-tune AI systems without written permission. This project performs research inference only. The review does not determine rights in independently authored fixtures or generated transcripts.
Keep raw records in the ignored .local/ai-village-source cache; the public demo must not depend on continued gated access.
